desc: Derive visibility condition: building i visible from (0,h) iff (H_i-h)/X_i > max_{j<i} (H_j-h)/X_j.
Reduce to strict increase of g_i(h)=(H_i-h)/X_i, equivalent to adjacent thresholds T_i=(H_i*X_{i+1}-H_{i+1}*X_i)/(X_{i+1}-X_i).
Establish answer = M = max_i T_i if M>=0 else -1 (N==1 gives -1); verified arithmetically on all 4 samples.
Fix output to 18 decimal places (`:.18f`) so the printed string matches the sample format exactly; keep exact-fraction max and the N==1 / M<0 -> -1 handling; all 4 samples confirmed string-exact.
